lineage.note: Humboldt CSI's official Durban Poison S1 page lists Durban Poison × Durban Poison. Together with the official S1 designation, this is treated as a selfed S1 line; no additional ancestry is inferred.

aromas.note: The breeder's description of the source cut is not generalized into cultivar-wide aroma claims for every plant in the Durban Poison S1 line.

terpenes.note: The breeder mentions terpinolene for the source cut, but no cultivar-specific lot COA or bounded S1-line terpene dataset is provided, so no S1-wide terpene profile is asserted.

origin.note: The official Durban Poison S1 page does not state the S1 line's exact creation location; no location is inferred.

history.note: The official Durban Poison S1 page describes the source cut but does not provide a sufficiently bounded S1-line release chronology; no secondary history is imported.
